source: 689 Precision
target: 689 Praecisio

source: Although Lumian’s target was clear, he didn’t immediately attack Hisoka’s dream projection.
target: Quamquam scopus Lumiani clarus erat, non statim oppugnavit imaginem somnii Hisokae.

source: This was because his opponent was still beside the black ancient tomb, and under the gaze of three items with godhood power, Lumian might be targeted by all of them if he teleported over.
target: Hoc enim erat, quia adversarius eius adhuc iuxta antiquum tumulum nigrum stabat, et sub aspectu trium rerum divinitatis praeditarum Lumian ab omnibus incideret, si se translataret.

source: The three items hadn’t reached the point where Lumian couldn’t be under their gaze simultaneously, and they appeared to last only a few minutes.
target: Tres res nondum ad statum pervenerant quo Lumian eorum conspectu simul esse non posset, et videbantur tantum paucis minutis manere.

source: However, they displayed certain humanoid characteristics, as if they possessed the ability to think and make decisions on their own.
target: Sed tamen certas notas humanoides ostendebant, quasi propriam facultatem ad cogitandum et iudicandum haberent.

source: If targeted by them, it would be no different from facing weakened Sequence 4 demigods.
target: Si ab illis destinatus esset, nihil differebat ab adversitate contra debilitatos “Sequence 4” semideos.

source: Under such circumstances, Lumian naturally wouldn’t take the initiative to enter the eye of the storm and help “Hisoka” Twanaku share the burden.
target: Sub his condicionibus, Lumian naturaliter non caperet inceptum ingredi in oculum tempestatis atque “Hisoka” Twanaku adiuvare ut onus communicarentur.

source: He even felt that if his rival was killed by an outsider whom he had personally attracted, it would be cause for celebration.
target: Etiam sensit, si adversarius eius a viro externo, quem ipse attraxerat, interfectus esset, id rem celebrationi causa fore.

source: It was inevitable—after all, since he had already killed Hisoka once, he wasn’t obsessed with obliterating the other party’s resurrection.
target: Inevitabile erat—nam cum iam semel Hisoka interfecisset, non animum haberet ad resurrectionem alterius partis delendam.

source: Having someone else “do it” for him could reduce his spirituality expenditure.
target: Quod aliquis alius id pro eo faceret, expensam spiritualem eius minui posse videbatur.

source: As Lumian gazed at the open tomb door, he retreated a few steps to the edge of the area.
target: Dum Lumian ad ostium sepulcri apertum aspiceret, paucis gradibus recedebat ad marginem loci.

source: He quickly said to Amandina, Camus, Rhea, and Lugano, “Retreat to the edge!”
target: Celeriter Amandinae, Camus, Rheae, et Luganoni inquit: “Recedite ad margines!”

source: Upon hearing this order, Lugano’s face lit up with happiness.
target: Audito hoc imperio, vultus Luganonis laetitiae splenduit.

source: He was the first to turn around and sprint away.
target: Ille primus se vertit et currens fugam iniecit.

source: Rhea raised her hunting bow, aiming left and right, taking slow steps back to guard against any attacks.
target: Rhea arcum venatorium attoluit, ad sinistram ac ad dextram intendens, tardis gradibus recedens ut adversos impetus obsideret.

source: Camus’s performance was similar to hers, but he held his custom revolver.
target: Camus similiter se agebat, sed tenebat revolverum suum proprium.

source: Amandina glanced at the sinister rag doll, the crystal skull adorned with a golden mask, and the green-eyed man with bulging human skin.
target: Amandina intuebatur ad pupam pannosam maleficam, ad calvariam crystallinam masca aurea ornate, et ad virum oculis viridibus cum cute humana protuberante.

source: She felt lightheaded, as if she was too exhausted to control her body.
target: Se capite leviter afflata sensit, quasi nimis defessa esset ut corpus suum moderaretur.

source: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫𝙤ѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: She instantly realized that these were things she shouldn’t come into contact with.
target: Statim animadvertit has res esse, quarum congressum vitare deberet.

source: What transpired beside the black tomb was beyond her ability to interfere.
target: Quod iuxta sepulcrum nigrum evenit, extra facultatem eius ad interveniendum erat.

source: She swiftly turned her back to the ancient black tomb and prepared to follow Lugano to the edge of the area.
target: Celeriter vertebat dorsum ad tumulum antiquum nigrum et se praeparabat ut Luganum ad marginem loci sequeretur.

source: At that moment, Lumian, wearing a grayish-white lightning-shaped brooch, glanced at the gravekeepers who were also hurriedly retreating and thoughtfully asked Amandina, “Where’s that figure?”
target: Illo momento, Lumian, indutus fibula fulminiformis cinereo-alba, aspiciens custodes sepulchrorum (qui celeriter recedebant) Amandinae cum medita quaesivit: “Ubi est illa figura?”

source: Amandina ran nimbly, synchronizing her movements with her breathing as she replied, “I don’t know! He’s gone!”
target: Amandina celeriter cucurrit, motus suos cum spiritu congruentes, atque respondit: “Nescio! Abiit!”

source: As soon as she finished speaking, the illusory water reverberating in the black tomb ceased.
target: Statim postquam locutionem finivit, aqua illusoria, resonans in sepulcro nigro, cessavit.

source: The palm-sized evil rag doll in the Gothic dress suddenly floated up, escaping Iveljsta’s grasp.
target: Parva pupa pannosa mala, in veste Gothica induta, subito levavit, evadens prehensione Iveljstae.

source: It hovered in midair, with “Hisoka” Twanaku’s figure reflected in its blood-red eyes.
target: In medio aerei manebat, cum figura “Hisoka” Twanaku in oculis eius sanguine rubro reflexa esset.

source: Twanaku, who was about to reach into the ancient black tomb, suddenly felt the golden mask on his face come to life.
target: Twanaku, qui aditum ad tumulum antiquum nigrum ferre parabat, subito sensit mascam auream in facie eius animari.

source: It first pressed inward, as if it wanted to crush his skull, then pulled outward, as if trying to escape.
target: Primum intus premebat, tamquam cranium eius conterere vellet, deinde extra trahebat, quasi effugere conaretur.

source: Hisoka instinctively raised his right hand to press the golden mask back, only to realize that his sleeve had tightly wrapped around his arm, immobilizing it, almost like it was tied up.
target: Hisoka, consilio innato, dextrum manum attoluit ad mascam auream repellendam, sed animadvertit manicam suam arcte circa brachium eius involutum esse, id immobile faciens, quasi ligatum.

source: Remembering the fate of a godhoodless individual losing the golden mask at the tomb’s entrance, Twanaku didn’t hesitate.
target: Meminens fatum personae sine numine, quae mascam auream ad initium sepulcri amisit, Twanaku non dubitavit.

source: His body became completely ethereal as he transformed into a Wraith.
target: Corpus eius omnino evanuit, transmutans se in umbram.

source: Then, he vanished from in front of the black tomb and reappeared in the pupil of one of the gravekeepers who had removed their golden mask.
target: Tum evanuit ante sepulcrum nigrum et iterum apparuit in pupilla unius ex custodes sepulchrorum, qui mascam auream removerat.

source: Due to the untimely demise of Hisoka’s physical body and his inability to get “assistance,” Hisoka had no choice but to modify his plan and wait for the three factions vying for the cold corpse in the ancient black tomb to begin fighting.
target: Ob mortem intempestivam corporis Hisokae et eius incapacitatem ad “auxilium” recipiendum, Hisoka non habuit aliter quam consilium suum mutare atque exspectare, dum tres factiones pro corpore frigido in tumulo antiquo nigro certabantur.

source: When the chaos reached its peak and the corresponding items were nearly depleted, he would re-enter the fray and compete for the corpse.
target: Cum chaos apicem attigerit et res correspondentes paene exhauritae erunt, in pugnam redibit et pro corpore certabit.

source: As Hisoka temporarily retreated, the area in front of the ancient black tomb became vacant.
target: Quam Hisoka ad tempus recedens, area ante tumulum antiquum nigrum vacua facta est.

source: Just as the palm-sized evil rag doll was about to float over, the crystal skull, adorned with a golden mask, flew diagonally, enveloped by a vortex-shaped body formed by the cold wind.
target: Ita ut parva pupa pannosa mala, in veste Gothica, pararet levare, calvaria crystallina, masca aurea ornata, diagonaliter volavit, corpus vortice formato ab vento frigido involutum.

source: Pale-white flames ignited in its eyes, with a hint of darkness at the center.
target: Flammae albo-pallidae in oculis eius accensa erant, cum obscuritas in medio adarsit.

source: In response, illusory black water seeped out of the black tomb’s walls, forming a silent river that blocked the entrance.
target: In responso, aquae illusoriae nigrae ex parietibus sepulcri nigri effluuerunt, formantes flumen silentii quod aditum obtexit.

source: The river was clearly similar to a stream, but it gave Iveljsta, Devajo, Reaza, and the others a vast and expansive feeling.
target: Flumen evidenter simile rivulo erat, sed Iveljsta, Devajo, Reaza, et ceteris sensum immensum et amplum praebebat.

source: Their bodies gradually turned cold, and their lives drained faster, irreversibly.
target: Corporibus eorum paulatim frigescere coeperunt, et vitae eorum celerius atque irrevocabiliter exhaurerentur.

source: The evil rag doll, clad in a black Gothic dress, hovered in midair, not attempting to cross the silent river.
target: Pupa pannosa mala, veste Gothica nigra induta, in medio aerei manebat, neque conata est flumen silentii transire.

source: The crystal skull, adorned with a golden mask, descended into the river.
target: Calvaria crystallina, masca aurea ornata, in flumen descendit.

source: The wind vortex that constituted its colossal body howled and expanded, as if transforming into an invisible ferry that floated steadily on the surface of the silent river.
target: Vortex venti, qui corpus eius colossale efficiēbat, ululavit atque expandebatur, quasi in naviculam invisibilem transfiguraretur, quae constanter super superficiem fluminis silentii maneret.

source: The crystal skull, adorned with a golden mask, steered the ferry against the current, slowly approaching the open door of the ancient black tomb.
target: Calvaria crystallina, masca aurea inducta, naviculam contra currentem gubernabat, lente appropinquantem ad ostium sepulcri antiqui nigri apertum.

source: The green-eyed man, dressed in a dark gray formal suit made of human skin and blood, stood at the back, observing the scene.
target: Vir oculis viridibus, indutus habitu formali griseo obscuro ex cute humana et sanguine factus, ad tergum stetit, scaenam contemplans.

source: With a smile, he opened and closed his mouth, as if silently muttering to himself.
target: Cum risu, os suum aperiens et claudens, quasi tacite sibi ipsi murmuraret.

source: Almost simultaneously, the crystal skull on the invisible ferry emitted a cracking sound.
target: Fere simul, calvaria crystallina in navicula invisibili sonum crepitantem edidit.

source: The pale-white flames in its eye sockets flickered violently, and tiny patterns appeared on its crystalline surface, causing invisible dust to fall.
target: Flammae albo-pallidae in orbitis eius vehementer micabant, et ex superficie crystallina parvae figuras apparuerunt, quas pulveres invisibiles deicere ferebant.

source: The ferry itself alternated between expansion and contraction, becoming extremely unstable as it slowed down on the River of Death.
target: Ipsa navicula inter dilatationem et contrahentiam alternabat, atque extremo instabilis eveniebat, dum in Flumine Mortis tardabatur.

source: Lumian paid no attention to the battle unfolding in front of the ancient black tomb.
target: Lumian nullam curam habebat de proelio, quod coram tumulo antiquo nigro exercebatur.

source: With a single glance, his body ignited with intense white flames.
target: Uno tantum intuendo, corpus eius inflammatum est intensis flammis albis.

source: Swoosh!
target: Swoosh!

source: He transformed into a flaming spear and crossed a distance of 20 to 30 meters, aiming at the gravekeeper whose body had been possessed by “Hisoka” Twanaku.
target: Se in hastam flammantem transmutavit et spatium inter 20 et 30 metra pervenit, destinans ad custodem sepulchrorum, cuius corpus a “Hisoka” Twanaku posseditum erat.

source: Hisoka raised his head, revealing a face with light-brown skin and wild beauty.
target: Hisoka caput elevavit, faciem ostendens, cuius cutis levis fusca et pulchritudo fera apparuerunt.

source: Rhea!
target: Rhea!

source: The gravekeeper whose body had been possessed by Hisoka was Rhea’s dream projection!
target: Custos sepulchrorum, cuius corpus a Hisoka posseditum erat, erat imago somnii Rheae!

source: Facing the rapidly expanding reflection, transforming from a speck of white light into a blazing white flaming spear with a burning tip, Hisoka didn’t dodge.
target: Adspiciens reflectionem celeriter expandentem, quae a parva particula lucis albae in hastam flammam albam cum accensa punta transformabatur, Hisoka non evasit.

source: He assumed a stance allowing Lumian to attack.
target: Situs instituit, quo Lumian oppugnare posset.

source: The blazing-white flame spear was incredibly fast.
target: Hasta flammifera alba incandescens incredibiliter celer erat.

source: He didn’t have time to raise his hunting bow, aim, or shoot.
target: Tempus non sufficiens erat ut arcum venatorium attolleret, destinaret, aut telum iaculari posset.

source: He only slightly bent his arm.
target: Solum brachium leviter flectit.

source: He felt a searing pain, as if his body and soul were about to be pierced.
target: Sentivit dolorem flagrantem, tamquam corpus et anima eius penetrare fore parerentur.

source: Hisoka showed no fear.
target: Hisoka nullum metum ostendit.

source: Instead, he chuckled.
target: Sed potius risum edidit.

source: The blazing-white flaming spear passed over his shoulder and landed behind him, failing to strike him.
target: Hasta flammans alba super humerum eius transivit et post eum cecidit, ne ictu illi perveniens.

source: The flames dissipated, revealing Lumian.
target: Flammae evanuerunt, atque Lumian apparuit.

source: The Hisoka in Rhea’s dream projection’s eyes vanished.
target: Hisoka, qui in oculis imaginis somnii Rheae erat, evanuit.

source: Rhea’s dream projection spun around, her expression cold and filled with hatred.
target: Imago somnii Rheae circumvolvit, vultu frigido et odio pervulto.

source: She raised her hunting bow, aimed at Lumian, and drew the bowstring.
target: Attoluit arcum venatorium, ad Lumian destinavit, et funem arcus traxit.

source: She was a dream projection formed by excessive desires and emotions, unable to control herself.
target: Imago somnii, ex cupiditatibus et affectibus nimis formata, se regere non poterat.

source: “Hmph!”
target: “Hmph!”

source: Two beams of white light shot out from Lumian’s nose.
target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naso Lumiani emerserunt.

source: Before Rhea’s dream projection could release an arrow wrapped in lightning, her eyes closed, and she fainted, collapsing to the ground.
target: Priusquam imago somnii Rheae sagittam fulmine involutam emittere posset, oculi eius clauserunt, et ea lapsa in terram corruit.

source: Rhea, who had just arrived at the periphery, trembled.
target: Rhea, quae modo ad limitem pervenit, trepidavit.

source: Her eyes reflected the black-robed “Hisoka” Twanaku.
target: Oculi eius reflectere solebant imaginem “Hisoka” Twanaku, indutus vestimentis nigris.

source: The strength of their souls differed significantly, and Hisoka easily possessed and seized control of Rhea’s body.
target: Virtus animarum eorum notabiliter dissimilabat, et Hisoka facile corpus Rheae possedit atque imperium suscepit.

source: Taking advantage of the fact that Camus, Amandina, and Lugano hadn’t noticed Rhea’s abnormality, he changed the direction of his bow and aimed it at Camus.
target: Ex his, quod Camus, Amandina, et Lugano de Rheae insolita natura non animadvertissent, directionem arcus mutavit et in Camum destinavit.

source: Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle.
target: Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle.

source: The arrowhead became engulfed in bright lightning.
target: Caput sagittae in fulmine claro involutum est.

source: As soon as Rhea aimed her bow and arrow at Camus, he sensed her incongruent state and noticed her abnormal behavior.
target: Dum Rhea arcum et sagittam in Camum destinabat, Camus statum eius incongruum sensit atque morum insolentiam animadvertit.

source: As a member of the patrol team with considerable combat experience, Camus looked at Rhea without hesitation, his eyes flashing with blinding lightning.
target: Ut membrum turmae vigilarum cum nota experientia pugnandi, Camus Rheae aspexit sine haesitatione, oculis fulmine caecante micantibus.

source: Simultaneously, Hisoka, who had anticipated this, detached from Rhea’s body and leaped into Amandina’s beautiful azure eyes.
target: Simul, Hisoka, quod hoc praevidebat, se a corpore Rheae disiunxit et in oculis Amandinae caeruleis pulcherrimis saliit.

source: Two blinding lightning bolts shot out of Camus’s eyes and drilled into Rhea’s head.
target: Duo fulmina caecantia ex oculis Camusi erupere et in caput Rheae infixa sunt.

source: Rhea’s eyes bulged, and her mouth gaped open.
target: Oculi Rheae eminent, et os eius late patefactum est.

source: She leaned back, as if she had suffered a heavy blow, but she couldn’t make a sound of pain.
target: Se retraxit, quasi grave ictum perpessisset, sed sonum doloris edere non potuit.

source: Psychic Piercing!
target: Psychic Piercing!

source: Camus’s Psychic Piercing struck her before her arrow could leave the bowstring, causing her to feel pain from the depths of her soul.
target: Perforatio psychica Camusi eam percussit, antequam sagitta funem arcus relinqueret, faciens ut dolorem ab intimis partibus animae sentiret.

source: Her mind went blank as she stood rooted to the ground.
target: Mens eius vacua facta est, dum in terra radicata staret.

source: Poof. The arrow, engulfed in bright lightning, shot out unsteadily, missing Camus and flying a short distance away.
target: Poof. Sagitta, in fulmine claro implicata, instabiliter exsiliit, Camum non attingens atque parvo spatio vagans.

source: Amandina, with “Hisoka” Twanaku’s figure reflected in her azure eyes, felt a chill run down her spine.
target: Amandina, cum imago “Hisoka” Twanaku in oculis caeruleis reflexa esset, frigus per spinam descendere sensit.

source: A dense coldness enveloped her, freezing her soul and rendering her unable to control her limbs.
target: Densa frigiditas eam implicavit, animam eius congelans et membra regere non sinens.

source: Behind her, Lumian’s figure swiftly materialized.
target: Post eam, figura Lumiani celeriter apparuit.

source: “Ha!”
target: “Ha!”

source: Lumian opened his mouth and decisively spat out a faint yellow blob of light.
target: Lumian os suum aperuit et decise exspuit globum lucis, pallidum et flavum.

source: However, Hisoka had no intention of stopping.
target: Attamen, Hisoka consilium intermittere non habebat.

source: He shifted his position with another Mirror Jump.
target: Altera saltu speculari suam positionem mutavit.

source: Thud!
target: Thud!

source: Amandina collapsed to the ground, unconscious.
target: Amandina in terram cecidit, inconscia.

source: Compared to Padre Cali, Hisoka clearly excelled in combat, possessing a wealth of experience and outstanding talent.
target: Comparatus cum Padre Cali, Hisoka in pugna manifeste excelluit, abundantem experientiam et ingenium praestantem habens.

source: This time, Hisoka appeared on a water droplet on the surface of a leaf more than ten meters away.
target: Hoc tempore, Hisoka apparuit in gutta aquae in superficie folii, situata plus quam decem metris distante.

source: He leaped out and looked at Lumian and the others with a smile.
target: Exsiluit et ad Lumian atque ceteros risu intuens aspexit.

source: He wanted to use Wraith Shriek to attack Lumian Lee and his companions in a wide range, rendering some of them unable to fight and temporarily immobilizing the rest.
target: Volebat uti “Wraith Shriek” ad oppugnandum Lumian Lee et socios eius in ampla regione, quibusdam pugnandi impotentes reddens et reliquos ad tempus immobilis faciens.

source: Upon realizing this, Lumian chose not to teleport outside Wraith Shriek’s range.
target: Hoc intellexit, Lumian decrevit non se teleportare extra spatium “Wraith Shriek.”

source: Instead, he withdrew his palms.
target: Immo, manus suas retraxit.

source: A blazing white fireball condensed, the size of the black tomb.
target: Globus ignis albus incandescens, magnitudine sepulcri nigri, condensatus est.

source: “Ah!”
target: “Ah!”

source: Amidst a piercing howl of pain, the colossal white-hot fireball flew out.
target: Inter acutum ululatum doloris, ingens globus ignis albus ac calidus exsiliit.

source: With a smile, Hisoka vanished from the tree and leaped into Camus’s pupils, where blood flowed from his eyes, nostrils, and ears.
target: Cum risu, Hisoka ex arbore evanuit et in pupillas Camusi exsiluit, ubi sanguis e oculis, naribus, et auribus fluebatur.

source: At that moment, the colossal blazing white fireball split into dozens of smaller ones.
target: Illo momento, ingens globus ignis albus incandescens in decurias globorum minorum divisa est.

source: Accompanying this transformation, the grayish-white Fury of the Sea brooch on Lumian’s chest erupted with bright, silver‑white, and innumerable bolts of lightning after he was struck by Wraith Shriek.
target: Comitante hac transformatione, fibula “Fury of the Sea” cinereo-alba in pectore Lumiani erupta est fulminibus claris, argenteo-albis et innumerabilibus, postquam ab “Wraith Shriek” percussus est.

source: The lightning coiled around the incandescent white fireballs and split into dozens, enveloping the area.
target: Fulmina circa globos ignis albos incandescentes se convolverunt et in decurias divisa sunt, omnem aream implicantes.

source: Rumble!
target: Rumble!

source: Amidst the consecutive explosions, Rhea, Lugano, Amandina, and Camus were sent flying by the wind and waves.
target: Inter explosionum consecutivas, Rhea, Lugano, Amandina, et Camus a vento et undis volitaverunt.

source: They suffered burns and were struck by a net of lightning.
target: Eis ustiones afflatae sunt et rete fulminum percussi sunt.

source: Camus’s entire body went numb, and his gaze lost focus.
target: Totum corpus Camusi insensibile factum est, et oculi eius conspectum amiserunt.

source: Hisoka, who was attached to him, also suffered an electric shock.
target: Hisoka, qui ad eum adiunctus erat, etiam ictu electrico affectus est.

source: Due to his Wraith state, he was severely injured and couldn’t undergo a new round of Mirror Jumps.
target: Propter statum umbraticum, graviter laesus est et novum saltum speculari subire non potuit.

source: Lumian recovered from the Wraith Shriek’s assault.
target: Lumian ab impetu “Wraith Shriek” se restituit.

source: He looked at Hisoka, who had emerged from Camus’s body, and his lips curled up.
target: Lumian Hisokae, qui ex corpore Camusi apparuerat, contemplatus est, et labra eius in levitate incurvata erant.

source: He was using Precision.
target: Ipse “Praecisionem” adhibebat.

source: The goal was to attack every target indiscriminately and ensure the damage was acceptable.
target: Propositum erat omnes metas indiscriminanter oppugnare atque laedem admissibilem efficere.

source: And when he launched an attack, he didn’t need to consciously control it.
target: Et cum impetum iniiciebat, id regere per conscientiam non necesse habebat.

source: The Fury of the Sea would automatically add an electric shock to all his offensive fireballs!
target: Furor Maris automatice ictum electricum omnibus globis ignis offensivis eius addebat!
